legend: The Impundulu, the lightning bird (South Africa, Zulu and Xhosa folklore)
lines: In South Africa, storm clouds carry an old and terrible story.
Zulu and Xhosa folklore tells of the Impundulu, the lightning bird.
It is a huge bird, black and white, taller than a man.
They say thunder is its wings beating, and lightning flashes from its claws.
In some tales it serves a witch, who sends it to strike her enemies.
You hear it before you see it, a rumble that shakes the ground.
Then the sky splits white, and a shadow with huge wings sweeps over the hills.
People hid indoors until the last thunder faded.
Next time lightning strikes, will you dare to look up?
title: The Giant Bird That Brings the Thunder #shorts
description:
